description: jQuery plugin source code for handling form element values, including get/set logic for input, select, radio, and checkbox elements.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the value of form elements, with support for functions, arrays, and hooks.

methods.name: valHooks.option.get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an option element, falling back to text if value attribute is absent.

methods.name: valHooks.select.get
methods.description: Retrieves selected value(s) from a select element, supporting single and multiple select.

methods.name: valHooks.select.set
methods.description: Sets selected options in a select element based on provided value(s).

methods.name: valHooks.radio.set
methods.description: Sets the checked property for radio and checkbox inputs based on array of values.

methods.name: valHooks.radio.get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of radio or checkbox inputs, defaulting to 'on' if value attribute is missing.
